title: helleborus viridis var. purpurascens
intro: Helleborus viridis var. purpurascens, commonly known as the Purple-Flowered Green Hellebore, is a variety of evergreen flowering plant belonging to the Helleborus genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor agent, and is said to have therapeutic actions such as reducing stress and anxiety, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Helleborus viridis var. purpurascens include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant's extracts are used in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations.
